description: File search and productivity launcher for Windows.
notes: This package requires an administrator shell and 'scoop install --global lertaro/lertaro-np'.
The official installer manages the application, Windows service, and .NET 10 Desktop Runtime in Program Files; Scoop tracks the package separately.
Settings stay in LocalAppData and ProgramData. Open a new terminal to use the lff command.
This shares one installation with WinGet and manual installs. Use one package manager to maintain it.
pre_install: if (!$global -or !(is_admin)) { throw 'Use an administrator shell and scoop install --global lertaro/lertaro-np.' }

script: # ponytail: use the stable installer directory; an upgrade must not uninstall the shared application or service.
if (!$global -or !(is_admin)) { throw 'Use an administrator shell and scoop uninstall --global lertaro-np.' }
